exp_industry_3m.label_zh: 工业品出厂提价预期 (未来3M)
exp_industry_3m.takeaway_en: Price intentions are positive (+15.3) but orderly; firms pass through costs gradually.
exp_industry_3m.takeaway_zh: 提价意向保持温和扩张 (+15.3)，企业遵循节奏渐进式提价，未形成恶性螺旋。

exp_services_3m.takeaway_en: Price intentions are positive (+16.2) but orderly; firms pass through costs gradually.
exp_services_3m.takeaway_zh: 提价意向保持温和扩张 (+16.2)，企业遵循节奏渐进式提价，未形成恶性螺旋。

exp_retail_3m.label_zh: 零售贸易价格预期 (未来3M)
exp_retail_3m.takeaway_en: Over net +25.2 balance of firms intend to hike prices; cost pass-through is active.
exp_retail_3m.takeaway_zh: 净提价企业比例高达 +25.2，行业提价冲动强劲，成本传导通道畅通。

exp_consumer_12m.takeaway_en: Households perceive persistent upward price drift; central bank vigilance against de-anchoring is warranted.
exp_consumer_12m.takeaway_zh: 居民对未来一年物价上行预期仍处于历史高分位，需警惕通胀预期脱锚与二次扩散。

capacity_utilization.label_zh: 工业产能利用率与瓶颈
capacity_utilization.takeaway_en: Significant idle capacity limits industrial pricing power; producers absorb margin compression.
capacity_utilization.takeaway_zh: 工业产能存在明显闲置，需求对生产支撑偏弱，企业定价权受限难以顺利提价。
